name: cilium
one_liner: The plumbing that lets big companies' cloud computers talk to each other securely and efficiently: the invisible networking and security layer underneath services like Kubernetes.
buyer: A platform engineering lead at a mid-to-large company running Kubernetes at scale who needs better network security and visibility than the defaults provide.
business_use_cases: A cloud consultancy offers 'Kubernetes network security hardening' engagements built around configuring it correctly for clients.
A managed-Kubernetes provider bundles it as a premium networking and observability tier.
An enterprise support company sells paid support contracts for teams running it in production who can't afford downtime.

money_ideas.idea: Offer implementation and hardening consulting for enterprises migrating to it
Sell an ongoing managed-support retainer for production clusters

steal_this: This weekend, write a very specific 'migrate from X to Cilium in a weekend' guide for one common stack and use it as consulting lead-gen; this is an infrastructure play, not a solo product.
